scenarios.name: Geopolitical Escalation (Middle East)
scenarios.description: Escalation of conflicts in the Middle East disrupts energy and shipping routes, increasing inflation and trade costs.

impacts.explanation: Energy price shocks from disrupted supply chains.
Higher import costs worsen trade deficit.

scenarios.reasoning: Historical patterns show conflict correlates with oil price volatility. Base rate adjustments for past Middle East events.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Supply Chain Re-localization
scenarios.description: US firms shift production back to domestic facilities due to geopolitical risks.

impacts.explanation: Factory output increases with localized supply chains.

scenarios.reasoning: Tetlock's 'outside view' suggests gradual shifts based on recent trends in manufacturing resilience.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between inside and outside views

scenarios.name: Fed Rate Hike Cycle
scenarios.description: Fed continues raising rates to combat inflation, tightening monetary policy.

impacts.explanations: Higher interest costs on federal debt.

scenarios.reasoning: Probabilistic assessment using yield curve expectations and historical Fed behavior.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Tech-Driven Productivity Surge
scenarios.description: AI and automation boost industrial output despite labor market softening.
scenarios.reasoning: Leverages 'outside view' of historical tech revolutions and current AI adoption rates.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the clashing causal forces at work

scenarios.name: China-US Trade War 2.0
scenarios.description: New tariffs on critical minerals disrupt global supply chains.
scenarios.reasoning: Balancing 'inside view' of political tensions with 'outside view' of past tariff impacts.

methodology: Applied Tetlock's probabilistic framework with scenario analysis, base rate adjustments, and error balancing. Weights each scenario by probability and aggregates directional impacts.
geopoliticalSummary: Middle East tensions and potential China tariffs pose material risks. Energy markets remain volatile.
geoeconomicSummary: Supply chain re-localization trends vs. risks from new trade barriers. Dollar stability under pressure from Fed policy.
currentEventsSummary: Fed rate stability amid inflation persistence. Housing starts weakness contrasts with resilient nonfarm payrolls.
